title: It’s just alright
text: I tried this out last summer when my son was 8. The UI needs a lot of work. The monochromatic colors, layout and graphics were not easy in the eyes or engaging, and they actually annoyed me. Coming from a graphic design background the app needs a boost in user friendliness and simplicity. The features like adding reoccurring weekly chores were not easy to set up or add an extra on the spot/or one time chore/project. However I did like the way the app allows the parent to pay and set up and view the child’s accounts and balances. In my opinion the functionality foundation was there but the dull color scheme and business of the screen took away from those functional and user friendly features.
